findings.location: clips[0].transcript: «Los sábados»; context.taughtBefore does not document sábado or los sábados.
findings.description: Understanding the answer-bearing expression «Los sábados» is essential. It is absent from the prerequisite map and has no vocabulary gloss in the prompt or hints. As ordinary A1 vocabulary, it may have been taught earlier, but the packet does not confirm this.
findings.suggestion: Confirm and document prior teaching of sábado and habitual los sábados, or teach/gloss the expression before assessment.

items.notes: The supplied transcript, Ukrainian translation and option c agree. Prior teaching of the essential expression is unconfirmed.
sources: Course contract rule 1: prerequisite coverage and uncertainty about unlisted vocabulary when answering depends on it.

findings.location: task.feedback.incorrectUk: «Напиши кілька коротких речень про день: що робиш, як часто і в якій послідовності.»
findings.description: The feedback redirects the learner to their own actions through «що робиш», while the prompt and rubric require describing a friend using él/ella forms.
findings.suggestion: Specify the friend's day and replace «що робиш» with «що він чи вона робить», retaining the él/ella requirement.

items.reviewerAnswer: Mi amiga siempre se levanta temprano. Primero desayuna y después trabaja. Por último, descansa.
sources: task.prompt[0]: «про звичайний день свого друга чи подруги (він / вона)».
